title: Split src/work_service/mod.rs into responsibility modules without changing the ambient work protocol
outcome: Mechanically extract cohesive helper families from work_service/mod.rs while preserving protocol paths, results, receipts, snapshot/delivery ordering and task-sync boundaries.
acceptance: Cohesive helpers move into private owning modules with narrow bridges preserving existing API/helper paths; existing operation modules and task-sync families remain in place.

Protocol behavior, refusals, serialized receipts, delivery/snapshot semantics, deterministic cost and response budgets, and selected test names/results remain unchanged against the retained pre-split baseline.
The final full landing gate passes on the integrated candidate.

completion.summary: Extracted cohesive private helpers from work_service while preserving protocol behavior and landed the reviewed contribution with query and docs at 582e736d297b8b91e284ccdfc1a05972027f6f7d.
